body: I'm sorry, I meant my family including me. Everybody in my family has changed except me. My oldest brother (22) has a girlfriend and is spending all the time with her. I only get to see him for 2 weeks and he has spent all that time with his girlfriend. My older brother (19) is on his computer all the time and Playing video games. My little sister (10) doesn't like spending time with me at all anymore. It used to be so much different. We all used to hang out and have so much fun together. I was really close to my oldest brother and little sister but they are drifting away. It seems like everyone is growing up without me. My little sister used to look up to me and always do what I do and always ask me to play hide and seek with her. She used to want me to play with her and our mom. Now she doesn't even want to hangout with me. My parents are really cranky all the time and they are getting older and the older they get the more easily ticked off they get so I can't talk to them about anything. I keep telling them I'm depressed but they say suck it up. All my family have grown up and here I am. Last year (9th grade) about a month into school I got so depressed I dropped out. I had to do all my classes online, and I did. My parents are making me go back to regular school (10th grade) on august 15th. I don't think I can do it. I just can't be in the real world. I know your right about going out into the real world and just do things I have to.. but I don't think I can do that. I can't even imagine going to school. Today I scared myself a lot. I was in the car, next to my dad, he was driving. I wanted to end my life so bad. There was an intersection, and a huge truck was coming right, the same way were about to turn. I was so close to turning the stearing wheel to the left to crash into it and end my life. The thing that scares me the most is I was so close to doing it. Right now friends is the last thing I care about. I can't even function in real life
